Wechat collector source attribution

Upstream: wechat-article/wechat-article-exporter
Repository: https://github.com/wechat-article/wechat-article-exporter
Commit: a7bffa6e481a188510a701d30b399b76573434e5
Source: shared/utils/html.ts (normalizeHtml and validateHTMLContent)
Source URL: https://github.com/wechat-article/wechat-article-exporter/blob/a7bffa6e481a188510a701d30b399b76573434e5/shared/utils/html.ts

Adapted into src/infrastructure/wechatCollector.ts: static article subtree selection, removal of scripts and article chrome by selector, lazy image URL extraction, whitespace cleanup, and WeChat error-page recognition. This implementation retains only plain text and public source media URLs, adds strict request limits and redirect validation, and does not reuse upstream CGI script execution, login or services.

The upstream repository is no longer maintained; this attribution does not imply that its historical bulk collection interfaces remain available.
